result.summary: The environment features a wide roadway with a traffic signal but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian-specific signals. The long crossing distance and absence of physical buffers or curb extensions create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians in a residential setting.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: Lack of painted crosswalks at a signalized intersection increases the risk of pedestrian-vehicle conflicts.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic without a refuge.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt can cause tripping or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian space.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-specific signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

result.summary: This signalized intersection in a residential area lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals. The wide roadway and absence of clear lane markings increase pedestrian exposure and risk while crossing.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite being a signalized intersection, there are no painted crosswalks to designate a safe path for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicle signals which may not provide adequate clearance time.

hazards.name: Wide Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide, open geometry of the intersection increases the time pedestrians are exposed to potential vehicle conflicts.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks on all legs of the intersection to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install dedicated pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to reduce crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The image depicts a wide, multi-lane residential thoroughfare with a signalized intersection that lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals. Pedestrians are required to cross a significant distance across four or more travel lanes without the protection of a median or refuge island.

hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross at least four travel lanes plus parking lanes without a refuge island.
